name: Clarice's Pendant
summary: Clarice's Pendant is a small keepsake belonging to Clarice Foster, an undead resident of the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff. Once a token from her former husband, Yuriv, the jewelry now serves only as a bitter reminder of abandoned family and misplaced devotion to the Light.

sections.title: A Bitter Token
sections.body: Clarice's Pendant represents the fractured human past common to many of the Forsaken. Before the Third War consumed Lordaeron, Clarice's husband Yuriv abandoned her and their children to join the fight against the undead, proclaiming that devotion to the Holy Light took precedence over all else. Instead of saving his home, Yuriv perished, leaving his family behind to ultimately succumb to the very Scourge he set out to fight. For Clarice, the pendant is not a cherished memento, but an insulting trinket symbolizing a lifetime spent coming second to zealotry and duty.

sections.title: Resting upon Yuriv's Tomb
sections.body: Wishing to sever the remaining emotional ties to her former life and unfaithful husband, Clarice sends an adventurer to return the piece of jewelry directly to Yuriv's grave at the Sepulcher. The tomb is neglected and vandalized, buried beneath weeds and trash. When the pendant is finally laid across the sculpted hands of the coffin, its gemstone turns noticeably dull, extinguishing the last lingering warmth of Clarice's former life.

aliases: who does the pendant belong to
faq.answer: The pendant belongs to Clarice Foster, a Forsaken woman residing in the Pools of Vision in Thunder Bluff. It was given to her in life by her husband, Yuriv, before he marched off to war.

Yuriv was Clarice's husband in life. He abandoned Clarice and their children to fight the rising undead threat in the name of the Holy Light, only to perish and end up buried in a neglected grave at the Sepulcher.

faq.q: Why does Clarice want to get rid of the pendant?
faq.answer: Clarice resents Yuriv for prioritizing his crusade and devotion to the Light over her and their children. His sacrifice accomplished nothing—he died anyway, and she was left behind only to end up raised in undeath, the very condition he sought to eradicate.

faq.q: What happens when the pendant is placed on Yuriv's grave?
faq.answer: Returning the pendant to Yuriv's grave fulfills Clarice's wish to part with the keepsake and the painful attachment it represents.

angles.text: The pendant highlights the tragedy and bitterness common to many Forsaken, whose living loved ones often abandoned them for crusades that ultimately failed to protect anyone.
Clarice's contempt for Yuriv's crusade is an uncomfortable reminder of the personal cost and broken homes left in the wake of holy zeal.
